mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_run (run_id, scope, conversation_id, model, question, status, started_at, events, created_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{scope}, #{conversationId}, #{model}, #{question}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{events}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE zzl_ai_run SET events = #{events} WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, scope, conversation_id, model, question, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, answer, error_message, events, created_at FROM zzl_ai_run WHERE scope = #{scope} AND run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1

SELECT run_id, scope, conversation_id, model, question, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, answer, error_message, events, created_at FROM zzl_ai_run WHERE scope = #{scope} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT run_id, scope, conversation_id, model, question, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, answer, error_message, events, created_at FROM zzl_ai_run WHERE scope = #{scope} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzl_ai_run WHERE scope = #{scope} AND run_id = #{runId}
